goal: Matched frozen-CLIP/project-Adapter frontend family comparison in the established Push-T diffusion pipeline

initialization.projection: Existing Linear1024to64, preserve native position columns64/65

data.feature_cache: Once-only FP32 frozen CLIP tokens; source global frame IDs select identical two observation frames

matched_training.tail_weighting: Actual micro_size divided by actual logical batch size
matched_training.sample_and_noise_plan: Exact native BatchPlan and independent frontend/diffusion RNG streams
matched_training.ema: Same native update rule and continuous counter
matched_training.segment_resume: Raw/EMA/Adam/LR/EMA counter/all RNG, complete-state digest proof; no reset

evaluation.development: Same20 environment seeds5000000..5000019 and same per-decision sampling seed plan
evaluation.interpretation: Frontend family includes preprocessing; cannot attribute all differences to Adapter alone
